scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance for Quality Certification
other_conditions: Certification must be from a recognized national or international body
The unit must have incurred actual expenses for certification and testing equipment
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of certification
MSME units with GFCI up to INR 10 Crore must apply to the General Manager, District Industries Center
MSME units with GFCI above INR 10 Crore and up to INR 50 Crore must apply to the MSME Commissioner for a Provisional Eligibility Certificate
Non‑MSME units must apply to the Industries Commissioner for a Provisional Eligibility Certificate
All applications must be submitted within one year from the date of completion (DoCP) or from the issuance of the relevant certificate, whichever is later
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to ₹10,00,000 covering 50% of certification fees and 50% of testing equipment costs.
